content.rendered:
Our ultimate review of the best Django website templates ensures you pick the right tool easily with zero doubt.

We thoroughly investigated each tool in detail, ditching the poor-performing ones and only keeping the most promising ones.

This saves you even more time, as you don’t need to determine which would work best. In short, these all work BEST!

But this is just one part of saving time.

All these Django templates are easy to use and come with heaps of great layouts, features and components.

No matter which you pick, you are on the way to successful app development.

Free Django Templates

1. Black (Free)

💎 Free

Why we like it: Modern dark-themed Django dashboard with exceptional design and 100+ components for rapid prototyping.

If you are as hyped about the Black Django website template as we are, you can start with the free version first. Hey, why not? It is still an amazing dashboard with thousands of downloads and 5/5 reviews—no joke!

You can work with Black to monitor your data and statistics easily. Keep everything as organized as possible from one location and that’s exactly what you can do with Black.

Sure, you may not get as much material as the pro version, but you can still enjoy a great start with the Black free template.

Download Preview

2. Argon (Free)

💎 Free

Why we like it: Bootstrap 4-based Django template with 100 elements, regular updates, and comprehensive documentation for beginners and experts.

You probably already noticed a pattern in this list of the best Django website templates: a mix of premium and free options.

Argon is a free alternative that follows the latest trends and uses only modern technologies. It’s based around Bootstrap 4, guaranteeing exceptional performance across all modern devices and platforms.

Aside from a collection of one hundred (yes, that’s 100!) elements, Argon also includes regular updates. This one is more premium than free.

Additionally, it includes four plugins, six example pages, and extensive documentation. You can even ask some basic questions in the comments section (on the official page).

Download Preview

3. Material (Free)

💎 Free

Why we like it: Material-Design-inspired Django template with 60 editable components, 5 color filters, and Docker deployment scripts.

Here you go, Material free. A simple-to-use Django website template that you can activate to set up a quick prototype. Note that Material is no random free template since it has sixty editable components. You even get five preset color filters!

Material works for management systems, CRMs, admins and the like. The Material-Design-inspired look also ensures the atmosphere of your new dashboard will be top-notch.

Moreover, Material also contains deployment scrips for Docker and Gunicorn/Nginx stack with other useful stuff that will do you well.

Why develop your next application from scratch if you don’t have to? You don’t even have to pay for it.

Download Preview

Premium Django Templates

For production-ready applications requiring professional support, advanced features, and regular updates, these premium Django templates offer exceptional value:

4. Vuexy Django

💎 23,000+ Sales (All Versions) • $42

Why we like it: Enterprise-grade Django admin with atomic design system and lifetime free updates across multiple frameworks.

Vuexy’s Django version delivers the perfect blend of modern design and technical excellence. Built specifically for Django developers, it includes 30+ pages, 60+ UI components, 5 conceptual dashboards, and 10 pre-built applications. The atomic design system ensures consistent, scalable development across Django projects with full Python integration.

Download Preview

5. Materialize Django

💎 21,000+ Sales (All Versions) • $35

Why we like it: Material Design excellence for Django with Google’s design principles perfectly implemented and regular updates.

Materialize brings Google’s Material Design to Django applications as the #1 selling material admin template. The Django version ensures seamless Python integration with advanced animations, comprehensive component library, and updates aligned with Material Design guidelines. Perfect for creating beautiful, consistent Django applications.

Download Preview

6. Skote Django

💎 15,000+ Sales • $39

Why we like it: Fully-featured Django admin with 7 layout types and comprehensive documentation for rapid development.

Skote Django is a premium admin dashboard template built specifically for Python Django with developer-friendly code and multi-language support. Includes Sketch, Figma & XD files, Bootstrap integration, and 7 different layout types. Features dark/light modes, RTL support, and is perfect for SaaS, eCommerce, CRM, and CMS applications.

Download Preview

7. Nazox Django

💎 8,500+ Sales • $35

Why we like it: Modern Django admin with Python 3.12.7 and Django 5.1.2 support, ensuring compatibility with latest versions.

Nazox is a fully featured premium Django admin dashboard template with developer-friendly code. Recently updated with Python 3.12.7 and Django 5.1.2, it features Bootstrap 5.3.3, 6 different layouts, and is ideal for building SaaS interfaces, eCommerce platforms, CRM systems, and project management applications with Django.

Download Preview

8. Velzone Django

💎 4,500+ Sales • $39

Why we like it: Clean minimal Django template with multi-language support and comprehensive design system files included.

Velzone Django delivers a beautifully crafted, clean & minimal admin template with Dark/Light layouts and RTL options. Fully responsive with Bootstrap 5.3.2, it includes Sketch, Figma & XD files. The Django integration is developer-friendly with multi-language support and clean Python code structure throughout.

Download Preview

9. Cuba Django

💎 3,500+ Sales • $35

Why we like it: Modern Django dashboard with SCSS-managed themes and comprehensive component library for rapid development.

Cuba Django is a simple and beautiful admin template built with Bootstrap 5.3.2 and Django. Features 6+ layouts and 3 modes (Dark, Light & RTL) managed by SCSS. Perfect for building SaaS interfaces, eCommerce, Crypto dashboards, CRM, CMS, and project management applications with Django backend.

Download Preview

10. Minia Django

💎 4,000+ Sales • $32

Why we like it: Lightweight Django admin with exceptional performance and clean code architecture for scalable applications.

Minia Django offers a simple and beautiful admin template built with Bootstrap 5.3.3 and Django. With 6+ layouts and Dark/Light/RTL modes managed by SCSS, it provides excellent performance and clean code structure. Ideal for developers seeking a lightweight yet feature-rich Django admin solution.

Download Preview

Creative Tim Premium Templates

11. Argon Dashboard Django PRO

💎 15,000+ Customers • $149

Why we like it: Creative Tim’s premium Django offering with 200+ components and industry-recognized design quality.

Argon Dashboard Django PRO sets the standard for modern Django admin interfaces. Built specifically for Django, it includes 200+ handcrafted components, 25+ customized plugins, and 16 example pages. Features advanced components like vector maps, sophisticated form elements, and follows the latest design trends with full Django integration.

Download Preview

12. Material Dashboard Django PRO

💎 10,000+ Customers • $149

Why we like it: Premium Material Design implementation for Django with Google’s design language and extensive customization.

Material Dashboard Django PRO from Creative Tim brings Material Design 2 to Django applications. Features 100+ frontend components, 30+ customized plugins, and 7 example pages. The Django integration ensures seamless Python development with authentication, user management, and database models pre-configured.

Download Preview

13. Black Dashboard Django PRO

💎 8,000+ Customers • $149

Why we like it: Stunning dark-themed Django admin with exceptional contrast and readability for extended development sessions.

Black Dashboard Django PRO offers a bold, dark-themed admin interface specifically built for Django. Features 200+ handcrafted components optimized for dark mode, advanced charts and graphs, and comprehensive Django integration. Perfect for modern applications requiring sophisticated dark UI with Python backend.

Download Preview

Choosing the Right Django Template

When selecting a Django template, consider your project’s specific requirements, Python expertise level, and long-term maintenance needs. The free templates are perfect for learning Django and building prototypes, while premium templates offer production-ready features, professional support, and regular updates aligned with Django’s release cycle.

All premium templates listed include lifetime updates, comprehensive documentation, and are built following Django best practices, ensuring your application remains maintainable and scalable.
